Subject: Hosted API rate card + competitor alignment request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the product demo last week — DataForge is interested in a Hosted API path for inference as we scale our recommendation pipelines. Procurement asked me to gather a few concrete numbers so they can compare:

- Could you send your current public rate card for hosted text-generation + embeddings (list & committed tiers)?
- Any standard discount bands for 12/24 month committed spend?
- Do you have egress or logging fees for hosted customers?
- We were asked to check competitor pricing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Together, AWS Bedrock). If you can indicate how Redwood's baseline compares that would help.

For context: expected steady-state tokens ~ 30M tokens/month, with burst up to 120M in Q4. We can provide a usage spreadsheet if you want to run model/cost scenarios.

Also copy-pasting a snippet of our procurement note — they highlighted matching parity with any OpenAI/Anthropic baseline offers for initial term would make approval much easier.

Appreciate a PDF/Excel ratecard and a quick note about matching strategy.

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform
DataForge

Kim — quick take from pricing:

- We can offer a promotional match to OpenAI/Anthropic list for the first 12 months provided: 1) DataForge commits to >= $150k/month ARR for 12 months (or equivalent token commit), and 2) they agree to a simple auto-renew. That preserves our blended margin.
- Suggested promotional bands: match baseline text-generation list to $0.60 / 1k tokens equivalent (example band) for 12 months, and embeddings at 40% off list for the same period.
- We should exclude extraordinary SLA credits and keep canary fallback to Redwood-verified smaller models for cost control.
- No egress fee for hosted; logging beyond 90d is billable as add-on (confirm with Evelyn on ops).

If they push to require parity + deeper concessions (extended credits, large SLA credits), escalate to finance/leadership.

I’ll help draft an offer email once DataForge returns the usage sheet.
- Aditya

From: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@dataforge.io>
Cc: Ellen Zhou <ellen.zhou@procurement.co>, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Hosted API rate card + competitor alignment request

Samir — we ran the numbers based on the profile you sent (thanks). Summary and proposal:

- Offer: Promotional hosted bundle (12-month term) with a blended text-generation rate that matches the verified competitor baseline for the first 12 months, conditional on a minimum $150k/month committed spend. Embeddings priced at 40% off public list for the same term.
- No egress fee on hosted; standard logging retention 90 days included. Extended retention or log export is billable.
- Security: hosted account includes SOC2 Type II and customer audit logs; Private deployment evaluated separately if DataForge needs dedicated VPC or HSM.
- Exclusions: SLA credits limited to standard terms (no bespoke full-service credits in promotional match).

Next steps: I’ve opened a HubSpot deal (link below) and drafted a commitment that we can push to DocuSign once you confirm acceptance. If procurement wants to review competitor pricing side-by-side, we can accept a verified screenshot of the competitor offer as the trigger for the promotional match.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DF-2027-070
DocuSign (estimate): https://docusign.com/REDWOOD/DF-2027-070

If that sounds good, confirm and we’ll send the DocuSign. Happy to hop on a short call with Ellen to finalize terms.

Best,
